passage.english: The department asked me to write an article for the Italian exchange students. I originally wanted to use a lot of newly learned characters, but I had only written one page and already kept stopping to look things up in the dictionary. So I moved the information about cultural activities to the end and started with how to borrow and return books. Then I asked a student who had just arrived to read it. He knew how to get to the library as soon as he finished. He told me happily, “How did you make it so clear? I was afraid I’d get lost. Thank you!” I was touched.

text.traditional: 一間博物館請我們系上幫忙翻譯一篇介紹當地文化的文章，讓義大利人也看得懂。以前在課堂上，教授只要我們翻譯課文。這篇文章是給來台灣旅遊的人看的，他們不一定了解當地的習慣。我們一開始常常查字典，還好教授對當地文化的知識很豐富，第一頁很快就翻完了。教授看過以後，請我們把文章念給一位義大利校友聽。他聽得懂每個字，可是他不知道為什麼有人要把紅色的紙貼在大門上。我們才發現，只把字翻對還不夠，也要說清楚當地人的習慣。後來我們加上了照片，也多寫了一點當地人過年的方式。教授說，這就是他把翻譯課搬到博物館的目的。
text.simplified: 一间博物馆请我们系上帮忙翻译一篇介绍当地文化的文章，让义大利人也看得懂。以前在课堂上，教授只要我们翻译课文。这篇文章是给来台湾旅游的人看的，他们不一定了解当地的习惯。我们一开始常常查字典，还好教授对当地文化的知识很丰富，第一页很快就翻完了。教授看过以后，请我们把文章念给一位义大利校友听。他听得懂每个字，可是他不知道为什么有人要把红色的纸贴在大门上。我们才发现，只把字翻对还不够，也要说清楚当地人的习惯。后来我们加上了照片，也多写了一点当地人过年的方式。教授说，这就是他把翻译课搬到博物馆的目的。
text.pinyin: Yì jiān bówùguǎn qǐng wǒmen xì shàng bāngmáng fānyì yì piān jièshào dāngdì wénhuà de wénzhāng, ràng Yìdàlì rén yě kàn de dǒng. Yǐqián zài kètáng shàng, jiàoshòu zhǐ yào wǒmen fānyì kèwén. Zhè piān wénzhāng shì gěi lái Táiwān lǚyóu de rén kàn de, tāmen bù yídìng liǎojiě dāngdì de xíguàn. Wǒmen yì kāishǐ chángcháng chá zìdiǎn, háihǎo jiàoshòu duì dāngdì wénhuà de zhīshì hěn fēngfù, dì yī yè hěn kuài jiù fān wán le. Jiàoshòu kàn guo yǐhòu, qǐng wǒmen bǎ wénzhāng niàn gěi yí wèi Yìdàlì xiàoyǒu tīng. Tā tīng de dǒng měi ge zì, kěshì tā bù zhīdào wèishénme yǒu rén yào bǎ hóngsè de zhǐ tiē zài dàmén shàng. Wǒmen cái fāxiàn, zhǐ bǎ zì fān duì hái bú gòu, yě yào shuō qīngchǔ dāngdì rén de xíguàn. Hòulái wǒmen jiā shàng le zhàopiàn, yě duō xiě le yìdiǎn dāngdì rén guònián de fāngshì. Jiàoshòu shuō, zhè jiù shì tā bǎ fānyì kè bān dào bówùguǎn de mùdì.
text.english: A museum asked our department to translate an article about local culture into Italian. In class, our professor had only asked us to translate texts from the course book. This time our readers were tourists visiting Taiwan, who might know little about local culture. At first we often looked things up in the dictionary. Luckily, our professor knew a lot about the local culture, so we finished the first page quickly. After reading it, the professor asked us to read the article aloud to an Italian alumnus. He understood every word but could not work out why people stick red paper on the front door. We realized that getting the words right was only part of the job. We also had to explain local customs. So we added a photo and wrote a little about how local people celebrate the New Year. The professor said that was why he had brought the translation class to the museum.

text.traditional: 我在華語中心教中文十年了，我發現很多學生在自己的國家就學過漢語，筆試考得很好，生字跟語法都記得很多，漢字也寫得很漂亮，可是到了外面，連買東西都不太敢說話。所以從這個學期開始，我們改變了教法：課堂上少寫一點，多說一點，期末考口試的分數也從二十分增加到五十分。剛開始，不少學生很煩惱，他們說自己的聲調不好，怕說錯了別人聽不懂。可是一個學期以後，大部分的人都敢在課堂上表達自己的意見了，有的還跟我說，現在去夜市殺價也不怕了。從筆試的分數看不出這些改變，可是學生自己知道，他們用中文跟人說話的方式不一樣了。
text.simplified: 我在华语中心教中文十年了，我发现很多学生在自己的国家就学过汉语，笔试考得很好，生字跟语法都记得很多，汉字也写得很漂亮，可是到了外面，连买东西都不太敢说话。所以从这个学期开始，我们改变了教法：课堂上少写一点，多说一点，期末考口试的分数也从二十分增加到五十分。刚开始，不少学生很烦恼，他们说自己的声调不好，怕说错了别人听不懂。可是一个学期以后，大部分的人都敢在课堂上表达自己的意见了，有的还跟我说，现在去夜市杀价也不怕了。从笔试的分数看不出这些改变，可是学生自己知道，他们用中文跟人说话的方式不一样了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zài Huáyǔ zhōngxīn jiāo Zhōngwén shí nián le, wǒ fāxiàn hěn duō xuéshēng zài zìjǐ de guójiā jiù xué guo Hànyǔ, bǐshì kǎo de hěn hǎo, shēngzì gēn yǔfǎ dōu jì de hěn duō, Hànzì yě xiě de hěn piàoliàng, kěshì dào le wàimiàn, lián mǎi dōngxi dōu bú tài gǎn shuōhuà. Suǒyǐ cóng zhège xuéqí kāishǐ, wǒmen gǎibiàn le jiàofǎ: kètáng shàng shǎo xiě yìdiǎn, duō shuō yìdiǎn, qímòkǎo kǒushì de fēnshù yě cóng èrshí fēn zēngjiā dào wǔshí fēn. Gāng kāishǐ, bù shǎo xuéshēng hěn fánnǎo, tāmen shuō zìjǐ de shēngdiào bù hǎo, pà shuō cuò le biérén tīng bù dǒng. Kěshì yí ge xuéqí yǐhòu, dà bùfèn de rén dōu gǎn zài kètáng shàng biǎodá zìjǐ de yìjiàn le, yǒu de hái gēn wǒ shuō, xiànzài qù yèshì shājià yě bú pà le. Cóng bǐshì de fēnshù kàn bù chū zhèxiē gǎibiàn, kěshì xuéshēng zìjǐ zhīdào, tāmen yòng Zhōngwén gēn rén shuōhuà de fāngshì bù yíyàng le.
text.english: I have taught Mandarin at the Chinese Language Center for ten years, and I have found that many students, who already learned Mandarin in their own countries, do well in written exams, remember lots of words and grammar and write beautiful characters, yet out in the street they hardly dare to speak, even when shopping. So this semester we changed our teaching: less writing in class, more speaking, and the oral part of the final exam went from twenty points to fifty. At first many students were worried; they said their tones were bad and they were afraid people would not understand their mistakes. But after one semester most of them dared to give their opinions in class, and some told me they were no longer afraid to bargain at the night market. Written exam scores do not show these changes, but students can tell that the way they speak Chinese with other people has changed.

text.traditional: 期末考以後，社區請我們在草地上辦一場免費的表演。老師跟學生一起合唱，附近的校友也來幫忙。我們本來想下午先練習合唱，晚上才表演。可是到了中午，天上的雲越來越多。還好社區的工作人員知道隔壁的教室沒有人用，要不然這次的活動只好停了。大家把樂器搬到教室，一邊休息一邊聊天，說著說著就忘了時間。有人走進來問幾點開始，我們才知道表演時間到了。我們本來在草地旁邊貼了換教室的海報，可是海報被人拿走了，不少人還在外面等。我們請校友去帶人進來，也請先到的人幫忙把位子留給老先生跟老太太。表演開始時，教室裡已經坐滿了人。
text.simplified: 期末考以后，社区请我们在草地上办一场免费的表演。老师跟学生一起合唱，附近的校友也来帮忙。我们本来想下午先练习合唱，晚上才表演。可是到了中午，天上的云越来越多。还好社区的工作人员知道隔壁的教室没有人用，要不然这次的活动只好停了。大家把乐器搬到教室，一边休息一边聊天，说着说着就忘了时间。有人走进来问几点开始，我们才知道表演时间到了。我们本来在草地旁边贴了换教室的海报，可是海报被人拿走了，不少人还在外面等。我们请校友去带人进来，也请先到的人帮忙把位子留给老先生跟老太太。表演开始时，教室里已经坐满了人。
text.pinyin: Qímòkǎo yǐhòu, shèqū qǐng wǒmen zài cǎodì shàng bàn yì chǎng miǎnfèi de biǎoyǎn. Lǎoshī gēn xuéshēng yìqǐ héchàng, fùjìn de xiàoyǒu yě lái bāngmáng. Háihǎo shèqū de gōngzuò rényuán zhīdào gébì de jiàoshì méiyǒu rén yòng, yàobùrán zhè cì de huódòng zhǐhǎo tíng le. Dàjiā bǎ yuèqì bān dào jiàoshì, yìbiān xiūxi yìbiān liáotiān, shuō zhe shuō zhe jiù wàng le shíjiān. Yǒu rén zǒu jìnlái wèn jǐ diǎn kāishǐ, wǒmen cái zhīdào biǎoyǎn shíjiān dào le. Wǒmen běnlái zài cǎodì pángbiān tiē le huàn jiàoshì de hǎibào, kěshì hǎibào bèi rén ná zǒu le, bù shǎo rén hái zài wàimiàn děng. Wǒmen qǐng xiàoyǒu qù dài rén jìnlái, yě qǐng xiān dào de rén bāngmáng bǎ wèizi liú gěi lǎo xiānshēng gēn lǎo tàitai. Biǎoyǎn kāishǐ shí, jiàoshì lǐ yǐjīng zuò mǎn le rén.
text.english: After finals, the community invited us to give a free performance on the lawn. Teachers and students sang together, and alumni from nearby came to help. We planned to practise in the afternoon and perform in the evening. But by noon more and more clouds had gathered. Fortunately, the community staff knew the classroom next door was free. Otherwise the event would have had to be called off. Everyone carried their instruments into the classroom and sat down to rest and lost track of time while chatting. When someone came in to ask when the show started, we realized it was already time. We had put up a poster by the lawn about the move to the classroom, but someone had taken it down, so quite a few people were still waiting outside. We asked the alumni to bring them in and asked those who had arrived early to save seats for older guests. By the time the performance began, the classroom was full.

prompt.traditional: 大家為什麼請校友到草地上去？
prompt.simplified: 大家为什么请校友到草地上去？
prompt.pinyin: Dàjiā wèishénme qǐng xiàoyǒu dào cǎodì shàng qù?
prompt.english: Why did the group ask the alumni to go out to the lawn?

choices.traditional: 還有人不知道要去哪裡看
choices.simplified: 还有人不知道要去哪里看
choices.pinyin: Hái yǒu rén bù zhīdào yào qù nǎlǐ kàn.
choices.english: Some people still did not know where to watch the show.

choices.traditional: 還有人在草地上找位子
choices.simplified: 还有人在草地上找位子
choices.pinyin: Hái yǒu rén zài cǎodì shàng zhǎo wèizi.
choices.english: Some people were looking for seats on the lawn.

choices.traditional: 還有人在外面等著練習
choices.simplified: 还有人在外面等着练习
choices.pinyin: Hái yǒu rén zài wàimiàn děng zhe liànxí.
choices.english: Some people were still outside waiting to practise.

choices.traditional: 還有人要把樂器搬進來
choices.simplified: 还有人要把乐器搬进来
choices.pinyin: Hái yǒu rén yào bǎ yuèqì bān jìnlái.
choices.english: Some people still had to bring in instruments.

questions.why: The performance moved to the classroom, and someone had taken down the outside poster. The alumni went to show the waiting audience where to go.
